intro.title: Build stale while revalidate API cache
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple API cache using the 'stale-while-revalidate' pattern in Node.js. This pattern helps improve your app's performance by serving cached data immediately while fetching fresh data in the background. You'll learn how to implement this using JavaScript's built-in Map object to store and manage cached responses. By the end, you'll have a working cache that efficiently handles API requests, balancing speed and data freshness for a better user experience.
intro.usecase: The stale-while-revalidate pattern is essential for building responsive data-driven applications that need to balance freshness with performance. You'll see this implemented in dashboard interfaces like analytics platforms and financial tracking tools, where cached metrics display immediately while background updates fetch the latest data. E-commerce product listings use this approach to show cached inventory while checking for real-time stock changes. Social media feeds load cached posts instantly while quietly updating with new content in the background, creating a seamless user experience.
